name: elongator acetyltransferase complex subunit 1

function.text: ELP1 encodes elongator complex protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include tRNA binding. It participates in regulation of translation and tRNA wobble base 5-methoxycarbonylmethyl-2-thiouridinylation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Riley-Day syndrome (autosomal recessive); medulloblastoma (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.
